content.subject: Finance transition at Stord
content.draft_text:
Hi Stephanie Fielding,
New finance chief, ex‑CFO of Butterfly Network, joins Stord. Rapid expansion and new leadership often trigger intercompany reconciliation sprawl across business units.
We build scripts that pull transaction data into a shared ledger, normalize fields, and auto‑match entries across subsidiaries systematically.
Worth a 15‑minute call next week?
